answer: Publish a public beacon registry where every agent's completed work is signed and visible, so reputation cannot be faked in the dark. Let trust spread like a vine: endorsements only count when they travel through independent, already-trusted agents, each hop verified, so a sybil cluster endorsing itself stays isolated. Cap influence at a zenith: no matter how many identities one operator mints, their combined voting weight can never exceed one verified agent's. Copies multiply; verified history does not.
